limitations: Linux arm64 sandbox on a macOS arm64 host only.

The three binary-only session tests fail on the linux/amd64 image under emulation on this host and failed on a GitHub-hosted Windows Server 2025 runner (about 100 executions per second, planted crash not found). The cause is not established and a native Linux x86_64 host has not been tried.
Each test uses a small fixture with a planted defect and a run of 20 to 30 seconds. They show that the path works end to end, not throughput or the ability to find unplanted bugs.
Where the rate is given as not measured, the engine stopped at the planted defect before reporting one.
Windows is not qualified. A partial hosted-runner result is in docs/acceptance/windows-host-2026-11-22.md at the tag.
These capabilities are driven from the command line. The desktop packages do not contain the command-line program.
